title: Two decrements in succession
statement: Let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $v$ assign a natural number to each of the 13 registers, let $r$ be a register, and let $\ell_0,\ell_1$ be two program states, with a destination state $d$. Suppose the program instruction at $\ell_0$ decrements register $r$ and moves to $\ell_1$, and the instruction at $\ell_1$ decrements register $r$ and moves to $d$. If every register initially has value at most $4(|x|+1)$, then the program can reach state $d$ from state $\ell_0$ with register $r$ equal to its initial value truncated after subtracting two, all other registers unchanged, and the safety conditions maintained at every earlier step.
